description: This PHP class defines a representation for the SplFileInfo object, providing parsing and property extraction functionality specific to such objects within the project. It extends a base class KintObject and includes methods to interpret file permissions, type, size, and path information.

classes.name: Kint_Objects_SplFileInfo
classes.description: A class that models and parses PHP's SplFileInfo objects to extract file metadata.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given variable to check if it is an SplFileInfo object and extracts detailed file information including type, permissions, size, and path.
